zh.title: 鞋履内容｜让产品成为人物叙事的焦点
zh.summary: 通过人物与手持鞋履的直接关系，把产品带入视觉中心，让鞋履内容兼具人物表达与产品辨识度。
zh.preview: 鞋履进入人物画面后，可以承担比穿搭配件更主动的角色。本案围绕这一产品主题结合形象准备与制作，交付人物和白色鞋履共同构成的内容。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与鞋履内容制作与妆造形象设计，将人物准备纳入产品导向的影像任务。
zh.context: 这是一项以鞋履为核心的人物内容项目。手持白色鞋履的呈现方式，使产品直接参与人物画面；制作需要同时处理整体形象与产品在画面中的地位。

narrativeSections.heading: 把鞋履带到观看中心
narrativeSections.text: 手持产品让鞋履成为人物表达的一部分，同时为产品提供明确的观看位置。画面由此建立人与物的直接关系，为鞋履主题提供不同于单独静物的表达方式。

narrativeSections.heading: 人物准备回应产品任务
narrativeSections.text: 内容制作与妆造设计围绕鞋履主题展开。人物准备服务于整体呈现，最终影像则将人物与产品一同保留，让产品任务贯穿制作过程。

narrativeSections.heading: 产品形象的另一种使用空间
narrativeSections.text: 人物与鞋履同框的内容可作为社交主题、产品介绍或创意讨论的视觉材料。交付的意义在于提供一种可见的产品叙事方式，让后续编辑拥有明确的画面参考。

deliverables: 配合鞋履主题的人物妆造设计
人物手持白色鞋履的视觉内容
outcomes: 交付人物与鞋履共同构成的产品主题画面。
内容可为鞋履介绍及后续创意编辑提供视觉参考。

en.title: Footwear in Focus | Product Meets Personal Expression
en.summary: A held pair of shoes brings the product into the centre of a talent-led image, combining personal expression with a clear footwear subject.
en.preview: Footwear takes an active role in the portrait. Image preparation and production served the same product assignment, resulting in content featuring the person and white shoes together.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to footwear content production and makeup design, making talent preparation part of a product-focused visual assignment.
en.context: This talent-led project centred on footwear. Holding the white shoes brings the product directly into the portrait, asking the image to accommodate both the person’s presentation and the product’s visual role.

narrativeSections.heading: Bringing the product forward
narrativeSections.text: Holding the footwear makes it part of the person’s expression while giving it a clear place in the frame. The direct relationship between person and object offers an alternative reading to a product still life.

narrativeSections.heading: A shared product focus
narrativeSections.text: Content production and makeup design addressed the footwear subject together. Preparation served the overall appearance, with the finished image retaining both talent and product as parts of the same assignment.

narrativeSections.heading: An image with editorial uses
narrativeSections.text: The person-and-product composition offers material for social themes, product introductions or creative discussions. Its value is a visible approach to footwear storytelling that subsequent editing can draw on.

deliverables: Makeup design for the footwear theme
Talent-led imagery featuring held white footwear
outcomes: The delivered image presents the person and footwear within one product-led composition.
The content offers a visual reference for footwear introductions and later creative editing.
